abilities.name: Illuminate
abilities.effect: Doubles the wild encounter rate.
abilities.flavor_text: By illuminating its surroundings, the Pokémon prevents its accuracy from being lowered.

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.effect: Prevents accuracy from being lowered.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon's keen eyes prevent its accuracy from being lowered.

abilities.name: Analytic
abilities.effect: Strengthens moves to 1.3× their power when moving last.
abilities.flavor_text: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's move if it is the last to act that turn.

abilities.name: Wind Power
abilities.effect: When hit by a wind move, the power of the next Electric-type move it uses is doubled.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

abilities.name: Volt Absorb
abilities.effect: Absorbs Electric moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.
abilities.flavor_text: If hit by an Electric-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

abilities.name: Competitive
abilities.effect: Raises Special Attack by two stages upon having any stat lowered.
abilities.flavor_text: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat sharply when its stats are lowered by an opposing Pokémon.

abilities.name: Pressure
abilities.effect: Increases the PP cost of moves targetting the Pokémon by one.
abilities.flavor_text: Puts other Pokémon under pressure, causing them to expend more PP to use their moves.

abilities.name: Pickpocket
abilities.effect: Steals attacking Pokémon's held items on contact.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon steals the held item from attackers that made direct contact with it.

abilities.name: Shield Dust
abilities.effect: Protects against incoming moves' extra effects.
abilities.flavor_text: Protective dust shields the Pokémon from the additional effects of moves.

abilities.name: Run Away
abilities.effect: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.
abilities.flavor_text: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.

abilities.name: Anticipation
abilities.effect: Notifies all trainers upon entering battle if an opponent has a super-effective move, Self-Destruct, Explosion, or a one-hit KO move.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon can sense an opposing Pokémon's dangerous moves.

abilities.name: Overcoat
abilities.effect: Protects against damage from weather.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon takes no damage from sandstorms. It is also protected from the effects of powders and spores.

abilities.name: Gooey
abilities.effect: Lowers attacking Pokémon's Speed by one stage on contact.
abilities.flavor_text: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.

abilities.name: Rattled
abilities.effect: Raises Speed one stage upon being hit by a Dark, Ghost, or Bug move.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon gets scared when hit by a Dark-, Ghost-, or Bug-type attack or if intimidated, which boosts its Speed stat.

abilities.name: Sand Veil
abilities.effect: Increases evasion to 1.25× during a sandstorm.  Protects against sandstorm damage.
abilities.flavor_text: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in a sandstorm.

abilities.name: Shield Dust
abilities.effect: Protects against incoming moves' extra effects.
abilities.flavor_text: Protective dust shields the Pokémon from the additional effects of moves.

abilities.name: Run Away
abilities.effect: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.
abilities.flavor_text: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.

abilities.name: Shadow Tag
abilities.effect: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon's shadows to prevent them from fleeing or switching out.

abilities.name: Telepathy
abilities.effect: Protects against friendly Pokémon's damaging moves.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon anticipates and dodges the attacks of its allies.

abilities.name: Intimidate
abilities.effect: Lowers opponents' Attack one stage upon entering battle.
abilities.flavor_text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it intimidates opposing Pokémon and makes them cower, lowering their Attack stats.

abilities.name: Frisk
abilities.effect: Reveals an opponent's held item upon entering battle.
abilities.flavor_text: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can check an opposing Pokémon's held item.

abilities.name: Sap Sipper
abilities.effect: Absorbs Grass moves, raising Attack one stage.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Grass-type moves. Instead, its Attack stat is boosted.
